The on-site is now **Tuesday Dec 15 to Thursday Dec 17, 2026**, at the Austin office. Sources disagree, so check before you book.

- On Nov 16, the assessor (Victor Lindqvist, Ardent) asked to move the on-site from Dec 8-10 to Dec 15-17. His second assessor had a conflict. Shira agreed the same day and said she'd tell the team [3].
- The original Dec 8-10 dates were in the SOW [4].
- A Slack reminder on Nov 17 from Avi Kessler still says Dec 8-10 and tells people to book flights by the end of the week [2]. It was posted after the change, but it looks like it wasn't updated. I found nothing that says the move was reversed.
- The Dec 1 evidence package deadline hasn't changed [3].

Please confirm with Shira or Avi before you pay for the flight. Also, the Austin holiday party is Fri Dec 11 and the TLV party is Thu Dec 17 [5]. Dec 17 is the last audit day.
